note: Iowa DNR park on Upper and Lower Pine Lake and the Iowa River near Eldora. One campground in open-grown trees west of the lake, with 22 long pull-throughs; the east loop's outer sites look toward the lake past the loop road and a shoreline tree belt. Boat ramps, fishing jetties and an unsupervised beach; CCC lodge and four stone cabins. Modern restrooms and showers close for the season in mid-October; hydrants and dump stay on. No daily Iowa park-entry fee. --Claude

flags: WATERFRONT (down, lakefront -> lakeview): ReserveAmerica tags every one of the 76 sites 'Near Water - no'. The DNR map draws the east loop's road along the outside of sites 64-71, between them and the lake; NAIP puts the nearest pads (70, 71) ~35-50 m from the waterline with that road, a paved trail and a shoreline tree belt between. No site has open land to the water. Site 71's ReserveAmerica photo shows open lake and the far shore beyond the pad, which earns the *view. Evidence string: 'RA Near Water no x76 + DNR map (loop road outside 64-71) + NAIP 42.37605,-93.06620: nearest pads 35-50 m, road/trail/trees between; site 71 RA photo shows the lake -> lakeview'.

FEES (high 26 -> 24) and a wrong-park source: the stored fees provenance cites 'iowastateparks.reserveamerica.com parkId 610142 (site list; sampled sites priced 2026-10-14 and 2026-10-20)', but parkId 610142 is Lewis and Clark State Park, not Pine Lake (610114). The stored note's 'booking site charges full hookups peak $38 ... electric peak $26' came from that other park. Pine Lake's own ReserveAmerica rates are electric $20 off-peak / $24 peak and full hookups $20 / $36, matching the DNR sheet figures the stored note quotes. reservation_fee 4.5 and the surcharges were not re-checked and are left as stored.

FIT: the 8 non-electric sites (25-28, 59-62) are '20 Back-In' only, so the base is the $20 off-peak electric rate. 64 electric sites take 25-105 ft.
